items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: We talked to Mrs. Oliver, Joe Oliver's wife, Mrs. Stella Oliver.

ctx.x: Well, I just laughed and talked about Joe. We were just talking about Joe. And some of them boys, you know, he taught. Did you say he taught Joe Oliver? He taught Joe. He taught Joe. And many times, he'd give somebody else a present. I'd say, well, they never say nothing about Joe, Steve and Joe. And I know that. He taught Joe and Joe played in his brass band. And when he got the string band, as they call in those days, and used to play out of the lake for all the country clubs and all the places out of the lake.…
We talked to Mrs. Oliver, Joe Oliver's wife, Mrs. Stella Oliver. Yeah. She couldn't remember the name of his teacher.

She couldn't remember. Well, George taught him. I know that much. George taught him. I don't know who else taught him. I know. I'd ask him if Mrs. Perkins and he said no. I know that. And he taught him. He taught him how to play in the string music. With the string music. And I said often he'd come. But they're always in my home. I knew them well. I knew all of them. I knew all of them. Manuel Moneta is another one.
